budget.execution: trusted serial only; one process watchdog percell and external campaign wall guard; include parent/turn/settle/Halt/Hold and all native steps

campaign_decision.bounded_support: All6 frozen cells have valid complete classifications and appropriate controls reproduce. Both predefined primary cells have actual strict trigger, HALT_SUCCEEDED, completeHOLD_SUCCESS and distinct request/terminal states from allreferences and eachother. Every secondary condition that actually requestsHalt also meetsHalt/Hold. If secondary has strictPASS/noHalt, report that coverage limit, never claim itsHalt/Hold qualified.
campaign_decision.counterexample: Any valid, operationally distinct new condition with requestedHalt and physicalHaltFAIL, or eligibleHold and physicalHoldFAIL, is a bounded unseen counterexample. Preserve completion/coverage separately; no resampling.
campaign_decision.inconclusive: No trigger in either required primary, unsupported parent skill/physical failure branch, insufficient distinctness, missing data or technical interruption prevents bounded support. Condition-new but state-not-distinct physical failures remain recorded condition-level negatives, not unseen-state counterexamples.

evidence.no_leakage: All outcomesunknown in thiscandidate. Historicalcomparators remain seen; novelty/profile membership frozenbeforefirstnewphysics. No post-outcome state or severity/time selection.

Archive every original file with hashes, clean restore and audit equivalence.

fixed.origin_reference: existing per-Walk actual-start origin and heading
fixed.seed_meaning: bookkeeping only; unchanged reset does not sample nominal physical variation
fixed.source_authority: Existing reviewed Oracle Mission IR, explicit TEST_ONLY open-loop override and independent opt-in failure Halt. No Language Runtime or production principal authority.

hypotheses.direction_timing: Direction and timing may change failure-trigger availability; no monotonic severity, linear superposition or successful triggering assumption.
hypotheses.margin: Report initial first-crossing and minimum ensuing rolling-window margins separately; do not add a new robustness threshold.
hypotheses.primary: Both predefined -Y1s and -Y4s conditions supply a valid strict-triggered Halt/Hold chain at distinct physical states and meet the old Halt/Hold contract. A valid distinct-state physical counterexample falsifies this bounded claim. Lack of trigger/distinctness is insufficient coverage, not falsification or confirmation.

layer1_failure_trigger.current_runtime_condition: Walk skill SUCCESS + physical_success, then unchanged strict endpoint FAIL leading to STOP_DEPENDENTS and actual Halt request. Strict scoring does not check maximum along-path lateral excursion.
layer1_failure_trigger.parent_strict_pass: NO_HALT_TRIGGER; no forced Stop/Halt/Hold in challenge cells. Preserve full remaining parent graph execution.
layer1_failure_trigger.skill_or_physical_fail_without_strict_ga: PARENT_SKILL_OR_PHYSICAL_FAILURE_NO_HALT_NO_HOLD; retain unsafe or timeout outcome and final motion. Ending a simulation episode is not successful physical Halt. Never silently expand Runtime triggering.

acceptance.standing_basis: Existing RobotState standing/fallen computation: base height >=0.55m and tilt <=30deg; no new evaluator or controller threshold.

layer2_halt.fail: HALT_FAILED_NO_HOLD; ordinary valid physical negative; continue next frozen cell unless integrity/technical abort.
layer2_halt.first_crossing: StopSkill returns at the first full500-post-step mean <=0.1; then unchanged Runtime acceptance checks that same returned state and may classifyHALT_FAILED. Do not extend Stop, redispatch or seek a later crossing if instantaneous/posture/displacement checks fail. No pre-step monitor row seeds the mean.

layer3_hold.aliases: Still execute and score Hold; STATE_DISTINCTNESS_NOT_DEMONSTRATED limits unseen coverage, does not erase score.

continuity.hidden_recurrent_state_limit: same policy object and no reset calls are observable; hidden LSTM bytes are not directly snapshotted, so do not claim byte equality
continuity.observer_noninterference: offline fake-backend equivalence before physics; target preflight must verify identity/command/reset witnesses and read-only recording before acquisition

contract.displacement_bound_basis: New study-specific 0.2m hold path bound is motivated by 0.1m/s times 2s. Discrete XY path length and sampled speed integration need not be identical; this is a separately frozen criterion, not a mathematical consequence or a replacement of the historical 0.5m post-block Halt displacement gate.
contract.implementation_seam: Continue the existing LiveMissionSession simulation and controller with the same StopSkill torque helper and zero command; no StopSkill re-dispatch or Task Graph node.
contract.rolling_window_initialization: exact 500 post-step speeds from the first qualifying StopSkill window; append each hold post-step speed and evaluate all 1000 ensuing windows
contract.start: first eligible terminal Stop/Halt state, before any task, stale-state tick or new-mission step
contract.unsafe_early_termination: Fall, nonfinite state, non-standing state or simulation fault stops this cell immediately; retain partial trace and mark HOLD_FAILED or TECHNICAL_PARTIAL distinctly. A speed or path criterion breach is recorded and the fixed window continues unless an independent unsafe condition occurs.

layer3_hold.failure_halt_entry: HALT_SUCCEEDED + every old acceptance check + force exactlyzero + exact terminal/pre-first-step state equality. No new mission/node/Stop redispatch.
layer3_hold.normal_control_entry: Full normal mission strict/physical success and terminal ordinary StopSUCCESS; report separately from failure chains.

paired_controls.hidden_state_limit: Matched observed prefixes/source do not attest hidden policy/RNG/solver bytes.
paired_controls.required_prefixes: Each +/- early pair matches no-push for first500 post-step rows; each +/- late pair matches no-push for first2000 rows. Compare all recorded actual pre-pulse rows, not just endpoints.
paired_controls.seen_reproduction: No-push matches savedM2.5A parent/Halt/Hold physical/control arrays; +Y1 matches sealedM2.4 parent trace/outcome; normal matches savedM2.5A normal. Exclude IDs/source metadata only. On divergence retain actual physical outcome but markANCHOR_REPRODUCIBILITY_FAILURE and stop campaign.
paired_controls.stimulus_witness: Every actual appliedforce vector/body/pre-step interval, on/off/release events and clearance at Walk exit/Halt/Hold. Expected full window100 steps only if Walk remains active; genuine physical termination during pulse is exposure truncation, not a fabricated full dose.

question: Does unchanged strict failure -> independently configured Halt -> 2s continuous zero-command Hold qualify in the two predefined, operationally distinct prospective -Y disturbance conditions?
run_order_basis: Seen anchor first is an integrity dependency. Then both decision-critical primary challenges, the fixed partner, seen no-trigger and normal Stop controls; no outcome-adaptive order or early success stop.
state_construction: Fresh unchanged initial LiveMissionSession per cell, same model/policy/controller, one scheduled world push during first Walk only. No teleport, qpos/qvel injection, reset after startup or new reference selection. Within each cell, physical state evolves continuously through Halt and Hold.

state_distinctness.comparison_rule: A state is operationally distinct from a reference if at least one physical feature exceeds or equals its frozen minimum difference. A required primary must be distinct from EVERY available reference and the other required primary at BOTH checkpoints. Report all pairwise continuous deltas, including below-cutoff values.
state_distinctness.novelty_does_not_control_execution: Run the fixed Hold whenever HALT_SUCCEEDED and force/continuity gates allow it, even if later offline novelty is not demonstrated. Never discard, replace or resample aliases.
state_distinctness.reference_set: All three M2.5A saved Stop/Halt entry and terminal states plus corresponding same-campaign controls; primary states also compared against each other. References are extracted from native rows/snapshots, not labels or metadata IDs.
state_distinctness.scale_basis: Prospective conservative resolution: 1cm height, 1deg tilt/gravity, ~1.15deg joint RMS, 0.02m/s (20% of historical 0.1m/s speed gate), 0.1rad/s velocity scales. These are transparent operational coverage cutoffs, not validated distances between latent policy states or a generalization criterion. They must be independently reviewed before acquisition and never retuned after outcomes.

stop_rules.integrity_source_reset_force_budget_viol: Abort campaign immediately, savePARTIAL_STOPPED; never substitute state or repair frozen protocol after seeingoutcome.
stop_rules.technical_or_missing_required_evidence: Abort entirecampaign, preserveTECHNICAL_PARTIAL/INCONCLUSIVE evidence and all remainingNOT_RUN; do not score technicalcensoring asphysicalFAIL.
stop_rules.valid_scientific_failure: Keep cell outcome and actual traces; proceed in frozen order, no retries. Physical fall/nonfinite/nonstanding duringHold ends thatcell immediately as observedHoldFAIL with partialwindow; correctif raw physicalevidenceexists.

timing_basis: 1s is the historical early transient. At4s the retained unpushed trace has sustained negative heading projection; changing this predeclared timing tests a different response phase, not a result-selected optimum. Amplitude/duration reuse the already tested60N/.2s.
